title: Backend And Data Engineering
summary: Backend discipline for contracts, persistence, migrations, concurrency, performance, and resilience.
instructions: Protect API contracts and database invariants.
Consider idempotency, transactions, concurrency, retries, and backpressure.
Use migrations and rollback notes for persistent data changes.
Verify with contract, integration, or targeted unit tests when available.
evidenceRequirements: Schema, migration, or model definitions for data changes
